action.recommendation: Create /embeddings for embedding pipeline and model selection. Create /retrieval for search and ranking logic (indexing, ranking, query processing). Create /ingestion for document processing, chunking, validation, and normalization. Create /knowledge-base for processed document store and metadata. Create /prompts for RAG-specific prompt templates.

rationale: RAG systems separate data retrieval (vector search, ranking) from text generation (LLM reasoning). Folder structure reflects this separation.

description: Choose and configure vector database for embedding storage

action.recommendation: Select vector database: Pinecone (managed), Chroma (local/self-hosted), Weaviate, or PostgreSQL+pgvector. Document choice with trade-offs (latency, cost, scalability). Configure indexing strategy (full-text, vector, hybrid).

rationale: Vector database is foundational to RAG; choice affects search quality, latency, and operational complexity.

description: Measure retrieval quality separately from generation quality

action.recommendation: Implement separate retrieval metrics (NDCG, MRR, Precision/Recall) and generation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, F1). Create test dataset with ground-truth QA pairs. Document that retrieval and generation failures have different root causes.

rationale: RAG systems have two independent quality layers; conflating them masks optimization opportunities.

description: Document processing, chunking, and validation for knowledge base

action.recommendation: Implement document loaders (PDF, web, database), chunking strategies (semantic/sliding-window), schema validation, and deduplication. Document staleness handling and cache invalidation policies.

rationale: RAG quality depends heavily on ingestion; poor chunking or validation leads to retrieval failures.

description: Prompt templates for context injection and generation

action.recommendation: Create prompt templates for retrieval context injection. Test few-shot examples for domain-specific generation. Document prompt engineering decisions and performance impact.

rationale: RAG generation quality depends on prompt quality; template management is part of production maintenance.
